_readme: Places where the Experiments (the AI wellness companion and the journal) are refused.
The informational site is never affected by this list: it is served from S3 and never reaches the API.
Each entry names a country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Add `region` (ISO 3166-2 subdivision code, e.g. IL) to block one state or province; omit it to block the whole country.
`name` is shown to the person being refused, so keep it readable. `reason` and `since` are for us.

REVIEW THIS LIST REGULARLY. State laws on AI-delivered mental health services are changing quickly in 2026: several states passed bans or disclosure rules in 2025 and more bills are moving. Check at least quarterly, and whenever a new law is reported. Set `next_review` when you do.
Changing this file needs no code change, but it does need a backend deploy (merge to main).

blocked.name: Illinois
blocked.reason: Wellness and Oversight for Psychological Resources Act (HB 1806, 2025) prohibits AI from providing therapy or psychotherapy services.

blocked.name: Nevada
blocked.reason: AB 406 (2025) prohibits AI systems from being offered as providing professional mental or behavioral health care.

blocked.name: Rhode Island
blocked.reason: Added at the organization's direction on 2026-09-16 as a state restricting AI-delivered therapy. Confirm the governing statute at the next review.
